roadmap.scope: ADO Bug #6575. Backend only (Lighthouse.Backend): the guard on DELETE for a Team and a Portfolio. No frontend, no UI, no migration.
roadmap.goal: With RBAC on, only a System Admin can delete a Team or a Portfolio, through any route: scoped admins and their API keys are refused and the row survives. Nobody gains access they do not have today.
roadmap.paradigm_note: C# .NET 10 / NUnit 4 / WebApplicationFactory tests. No DISTILL wave for a bugfix: RED is a crafter-authored regression test failing on today's code.

validation.reviewer: orchestrator (inline, following the bug-6424 precedent for a surgical bugfix)
validation.notes: RCA approved by the maintainer. Fix sites verified by the orchestrator: TeamController.cs:92-94, PortfolioController.cs:68-70, RbacAdministrationService.CanSatisfyRequirementAsync (:342-370); the SystemAdmin arm at :350 skips the enforcement gate that CanWriteTeamAsync honours at :233.

user_decisions: Dedicated CanDeleteUnit requirement, not the existing SystemAdmin one.
Rigor profile thorough (crafter opus, reviewer sonnet, double review). Do not push.
out_of_scope: Epic 6577 work, including Admin on all.
Docs: rbac.md is already correct. Release notes are written at /release.

phases.name: Only a System Admin deletes a Team or a Portfolio
phases.description: Regression tests, then the minimal fix.

steps.name: DELETE on a Team and a Portfolio is refused for everyone but a System Admin
steps.description: A dedicated CanDeleteUnit requirement guards both delete endpoints. The tests that used delete as a write probe move to PUT.
red_to_green_tests: Team Admin DELETE own Team -> 403, row survives
Portfolio Admin DELETE own Portfolio -> 403, row survives
Team-scoped API key DELETE Team -> 403, row survives
System Admin DELETE Team and Portfolio -> 204, row gone (already green, must stay green)
Enforcement gate unsatisfied (RBAC on, gate not met) -> a System Admin is refused, as today (already green, must stay green)
Attribute test beside CreateRightsControllerGuardTest.cs: both delete actions declare CanDeleteUnit and no scope route key
criteria: RED first: the three refusal tests fail on today's code with 204 instead of 403.
CanDeleteUnit has its own switch arm in CanSatisfyRequirementAsync: not enforced -> allowed; gate unsatisfied -> refused; otherwise CanManageRbacAsync. It does not call or reuse CanCreateTeam.
Both delete actions use RbacGuardRequirement.CanDeleteUnit with no ScopeIdRouteKey.
BE_1_4 in F_BE_1_GroupSnapshotInheritanceTests probes write through PUT on a Team with an empty body: 400 proves the guard passed, because the guard runs before model validation.
S5_ScopedReadKey_AttemptWriteAction_Returns403 probes write through PUT on a Portfolio, so it still tests a scoped write refusal.
dotnet build has zero warnings; the backend suite is green under the standard filter.
